thread:
Maya CSM: Heads-up — ZenParcel flagged as near-term downgrade. Renewal in 27 days, usage down 45% month-over-month. Quick triage?
Jorge CS Ops: saw the signal. Health score dropped after the new batch of shipments. Error rate with our SDK spiked for them last week.
Ava RevOps: do we have any outstanding credits or billing disputes on their account? last touch from finance was 'invoice 2247 under review'.
Maya CSM: no unresolved credits, but they asked for ETA on a latency fix in eng, which we haven't been able to promise yet.
Micah TPM: FYI eng PR to mitigate the SDK edge-case is queued — ETA for canary deploy is ~48h. Not immediate enough for renewal.
Maya CSM: thinking proactive save flow: (1) targeted enablement session this week, (2) temporary reduced rate for one billing cycle, (3) canary access to patched runtime once deployed. Thoughts?
Jorge CS Ops: agree. Also add a tailored success checklist and a sandbox where they can validate the fix without touching prod traffic.
Ava RevOps: reduced rate OK but keep margin guardrails. propose 15% credit for one month + opt-in extension to current term if they accept. @Maya can you confirm if legal OK?
Maya CSM: pinging legal, but I can get redline approved quickly if needed. I'll draft the offer text.
playbook-bot: Saved playbook template: https://confluence.redwood.ai/cs/save-playbooks/zen-parcel-template — includes downgrade path, escalation contacts, and rollback triggers.
Maya CSM: copying the proposed checklist here:
```
- Schedule enablement: within 72h
- Sandbox access + data subset: created by eng
- 15% credit applied for next invoice
- Post-fix validation session within 7 days of canary
- Renewal touch: CSM + AE on call 3 days before renewal
```
Micah TPM: can eng create the sandbox by EOD tomorrow? We can snapshot a limited dataset and apply the fix there.
Jorge CS Ops: I'll own the sandbox provisioning and monitoring alerts. I'll also wire up a short health dashboard for the customer.
Ava RevOps: once offer text is ready, I'll draft billing amendment and notify finance to queue the credit. Please include exact invoice numbers.
Maya CSM: done — draft offer below, please sanity-check and react :thumbsup: if good:
"We understand the latency impacted your workflows. To ensure uninterrupted operations, we'd like to offer a 15% credit for one billing cycle, a dedicated enablement session this week, and priority canary access to the fix. If accepted, we'll extend the current term by 30 days to allow validation."
Jorge CS Ops: looks good. add a line about the sandbox for validation.
Maya CSM: updated. sending to legal and AE now.
Micah TPM: outstanding item: if canary fails, fallback plan is immediate config rollback + extra engineering hours at no charge for 2 days. Add that to the offer as reassurance.
Maya CSM: adding it.
Ava RevOps: I'll prepare the amendment draft. tagging finance: @Leah-Finance — can you pre-authorize the credit if legal OKs the text?
playbook-bot: Reminder: follow playbook steps and mark the thread when "offer sent", "sandbox ready", "validation passed", "renewal closed".
Maya CSM: thanks team — I'll update thread as items move. Goal: convert downgrade risk into extension or renewal by next checkpoint. :raised_hands:
